eventDetail.scope: MTCE 2026 encompasses the theoretical foundations, design methodologies, and engineering applications of mechatronics systems and computational technologies. The conference addresses intelligent electromechanical systems, automation and control architectures, robotics, embedded systems, and cyber-physical infrastructures, alongside computational methods including machine learning, high-performance computing, and data analytics. Contributions bridging hardware-software integration, system modeling, and industrial implementations are central to the technical program. The event serves researchers and practitioners advancing the convergence of mechanical engineering, electronics, and computer science in industrial and emerging application domains.
